clue.text: Wrongly, I'm tied to kitchen range for specialised distribution

explanation.definitionFit: A short broadcast report of the news is a kind of communication to the public.

clue.text: Stick with cold fish

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
the ling is a long sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: Someone keeps company with a chilly fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To stick to something is to adhere or grip tightly, as a limpet does to a rock.

clue.text: Mournful Alice with a leg broken

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Nasty men get a bit on all sides

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: KNOW is spoken just like NO; 'to cope with' links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Practical know-how is expertise, the skill of knowing how to do something.

clue.text: Covered it up, having shown the way

explanation.definitionFit: A roof or floor covered with tiles is said to be tiled.

clue.text: One variety of peach, but a number can be seen outside the damaged crate

explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' signals the anagram of the crate; the number is split so its first letter stands before the jumble and the rest after.

clue.text: We must hold success to be spotless

clue.text: Arctic rocks unmoved

clue.text: Within part of the neo-Latin tradition
